skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply concepts of electrostatics, magnetostatics, electromagnetic induction, and Maxwell's equations.
Analyze and solve problems related to electric and magnetic fields, and their interactions with materials.
Evaluate the impact of electric and magnetic fields on materials and their practical applications.
Work effectively in groups to solve problems and present findings.
Effectively communicate complex scientific concepts and problem solutions.
Develop the ability to independently seek, gather, and analyze information.
